claim: The thesis object is a traceable combination of the DTU10MW reference turbine and a published 158m hybrid-tower prototype, not one official unified reference model

He2024 directly supports the 158=112+46m geometry, 31 concrete sections, longitudinal bar counts, reinforcement mesh concept and 15.2mm PT, but not phi25, phi14@80, phi6, 30mm cover or the BF8 bundle factor
T057 ordinary reinforcement HRB335 and steel tower Q345 are evidence-reconciled to the same 10MW/158m later peer-reviewed lineage rather than copied from He2024's historical S345 description

The current BF8 PT baseline is 36 bundle positions x8x140mm2 with nominal total area40320mm2 and nominal force51.6096MN; this is an independent-engineering/physics reconstruction, not a He2024 direct design value
T057 replaces the old 30-interface SPRING2 representation with explicit hard-normal plus penalty-friction horizontal-joint contact using mu=0.5 from independent test-validated FE precedent
RNA equivalence requires mass, eccentric CG, full inertia and a common reference point rather than total mass alone
Agreement of one natural frequency cannot by itself validate local joint/contact/fatigue behavior
ERA5 is used as long-term reanalysis climatology rather than site mast measurement or 10-min turbulent inflow
Time-varying hub-height shear extrapolation from ERA5 U10/U100 is better supported for this study than assuming a universal fixed 1/7 exponent
The existing 36 NTM/ETM x multi-seed OpenFAST cases are a screening data set, not a complete long-term material-fatigue DLC matrix
Load-DEL is an equivalent load screening metric and is not a material fatigue life result
The historical S03 28.177MNm DEL record and the currently archived outb recomputation pointing to S04 about26.8MNm are source-version divergent and cannot be silently merged
Material fatigue must be based on local stress cycles retaining range, mean and count and then use material-specific fatigue relations plus long-term wind probability
Prestressed-concrete fatigue must retain the gravity+prestress reference/mean stress state; wind-induced stress increment alone is insufficient for the intended fatigue interpretation
Concrete, PT strand and steel/weld fatigue are separate material branches and must not be represented by one universal m=4 load-DEL formulation
The fatigue-control material/location must be identified from thesis response results rather than predetermined from another tower's critical location
Every quantitative thesis conclusion must trace to a current RUN and FIG/TAB; historical benchmark values remain non-final until identity and gate closure
Any claim that load-DEL control and material-damage control differ is result-triggered and must be deleted if the final data do not demonstrate a stable difference
